title: Pantry Inventory Shortage Request Hotspots
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`community:shift`), donations (`community:donation`), mutual-aid requests (`community:mutualaid`), service ops (`community:impact`).
app: Community-service telemetry — food-bank shift logs, blood-donation records, and mutual-aid request maps — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=community:mutualaid item_name=* shortage_flag="yes"
| stats count as shortage_requests by item_name
| sort - shortage_requests
description: Ranks item by shortage requests volume for pantry shortages.
value: Volume rankings show which item are producing the most activity, demand, or friction inside pantry shortages.
implementation: Capture each shortage requests as a `community:mutualaid` event and normalize `item_name` so the totals are comparable.
visualization: Bar chart of shortage requests volume by item.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds which item show up the most in pantry shortages so you know where the busiest areas are.
